artifacts.summary: Eleven-phase plan consolidating the Core MCS API: one Zorn lemma, one bot_not_mem, temporal mono helpers, ofWeakeningNil plus BL twin, a four-phase mp_of_theorem sweep, boundedness retirement, and the mcs_auto rejection record.

memory_candidates.content: When planning a refactor that adds helper lemmas to an import-graph-root module and then sweeps call sites across many downstream files, hoist ALL additions to the root module into a single first phase, then make every sweep phase depend on it. Two payoffs: the tree pays only one near-full rebuild for the additions instead of one per work group, and the sweep phases stop colliding on the root file, so they become genuinely parallel-safe territory. Residual collisions (a sweep file also touched by an unrelated phase) are then resolved purely through per-phase Depends-on serialization rather than by re-partitioning file ownership.
